title: Rotate a TLS certificate
summary: Stage, validate, activate, and roll back an HTTPS certificate on an Apex Control Hub running version 2.0.

sections.title: Rotation plan
paragraphs: Version 2.0 supports staging a certificate before activation so clients can validate the complete chain.
steps: Export the current certificate fingerprint and rollback package.
Upload the new certificate and intermediate chain to the staging slot.
Run the built-in hostname and validity checks.
Activate the staged certificate during the approved window.
Verify two independent clients and retain the previous certificate until the window closes.
